balls.text: Fine finish from Sakariya on debut. Back-of-the-hand slower variation once again, full and outside off. Richardson can't quite get underneath it and lift it over long-off. Ends up carving it to Morris who takes it on front of the RR dug out
back of a length and outside off, another impressive slower ball from the back of the hand. Richardson throws his bat at ball, does so early, and is beaten
short and outside off, another slower ball, heaved away to deep midwicket
107ks dipper outside off, Shahrukh swishes early as the ball squeezes underneath to the keeper

full and in the slot around off stump, Rahul picks it up and swats it in the air. Rahul keeps Tewatia interested at the edge of the midwicket boundary. He gets into a side-on position, grabs the ball with both hands, but then realises that the momentum will push him beyond the boundary. He tosses the ball back into play, then jumps back to collect it on the rebound. Excellent work in the deep from Tewatia
full and wide outside off, 111.3ks slower ball. Rahul waits for it and then dispatches it over extra-cover
pulls the short ball on his hips to the fine leg boundary. Welcome to the IPL, SRK. Picks the offcutter and puts it away
offcutter outside off, Rahul cuts to extra cover for a single
cuts the short ball outside off to the sweeper and retains strike
slices it over extra cover. Mustafizur misses the yorker outside off and he's punished for it. Rahul on 84. Nine balls left in the innings. Sixteen needed.
too wide outside off. He'll have to re-bowl the free hit
looks for the reverse scoop, but the left-armer's angle and his length more importantly ensures Rahul can't connect. Course that's only part of the story, coz he's overstepped
pops a shortish ball outside off stump - off pace again - down to long-off. Not entirely controlled because he checks his shot, done in by the variation
outside edge to the cutter outside off. Only a single to short third man

taken at fine leg! This is superb stuff. Sakariya, take a bow! Pooran could be so dangerous at this time of an innings. And he had the perfect ball to start. A long hop well outside leg. The only thing going for it is the lack of pace, which is possibly why he doesn't middle the pull shot. It flies to the left of the short fine leg fielder. Sakariya sees it. Dives full length and grabs it two-handed. The umpires take a closer look to make sure he hasn't let the ball touch the grass as he game to ground. Replays suggest he hasn't. But they have to do their due diligence. Pooran is waiting. He's waiting... Awful long time to just stand around and wait especially after making a duck. Come on, umps. Let's get the game moving! Yep, it's out. And that's five minutes of our lives we're probably never getting back.
yorker on off stump, whips it down to wide long-on

feigns to step away to leg - which prompts Morris to bowl short and outside off - which is exactly what Rahul wants as he gets back in position and pulls viciously over deep midwicket. He's in Morris' head now. After those laps, he's so in Morris' head!

taken at long-on. Hooda has been hitting everything coming his way and he backs himself against a shortish ball. So much that his weight his forward and he's looking to take it down town. Unfortunately that kinda technique only rarely comes off. Gets it high on the bat. Gets more height than distance and Parag takes a simple catch. End of a superb innings and his coaches in the dugout really appreciate it
attempts another scoop, but this time Morris angles it into the right-hander and pitches it further up to prevent him from getting underneath. Inside edge to fine leg

scoops it away. It's a top pace ball. Seam up ball. Batsman a few years ago would've punched it through the covers. For no runs. Batsmen now walk across, get down on one knee and launch it over fine leg

outside edge spins away to the backward point boundary. Poor lad. He does well. Takes the pace off. Hides the ball away from Hooda's reach. But that's easier said than done. Hooda's a huge, tall batsman. He's got massive reach and it helps him scythe the ball away off a bent knee

pumps it down the ground! Hooda batting deep in his crease means any mistakes with the yorker become a six-hitting delivery. This is the Hardik Pandya (Also the AB de Villiers) method and it's been executed superbly by his Baroda state-mate. Oops, and he's overstepped. Sakariya started so well. He really did. He should be one to watch this season. But right now he is under massive pressure. Free hit ball coming up

digs it in and takes all the pace off - and well the length becomes his problem because it gives the batsman too much time. Or maybe just enough to adjust to the lack of pace and pull it over long leg.
back over the wicket and nails the yorker outside off stump. Hooda and his massive backlift can't get down quick enough. This is a special over. Nerveless stuff from the debutant
cramps the batsman with a 125 kph delivery climbing up above his waist. Rahul tries to slide it past point. Doesn't place it well enough for more than one
slower ball well outside off stump gets an inside edge as Hooda slogs like a rusty gate. Single to long leg. Good bowling this from the debutant
backs away from the round the wicket short ball outside off and tries to carve it over point. Makes no contact
Hooda shuffles outside leg, Morris follows him with a hard-length delivery, wafted to cover
low full-toss on middle and leg, patted down to long-on
slower ball outside off, 116.2ks, Rahul swings so very early and misses it altogether
tapped through the covers. 20-ball half-century for Hurricane Hooda. A warm hug from Rahul is part of the celebrations
Hooda shuffles across off, back of a length on leg stump, clipped through square leg
good length = bad length. On off, Hooda hangs back, and whiplashes it over midwicket, Guptill-style. Bam
Hooda shuffles across off, Mustafizur follows him with a cutter. The batsman delays his punch and strokes it to sweeper
slower-ball offcutter outside off, 101ks, flayed down to deep third man
shoulder-high short ball on leg stump, gets big on Rahul, but he manages to top edge it over long leg for six
offcutter on a back of a length and outside off, chopped to point
short and slanting away outside off, cut firmly to the left of sweeper cover
sliced in the air.... Buttler runs back and around from cover only to drop it. I think it should've been Stokes' catch running in from long-off. Cutter from Mustafizur, nearly gets Hooda
flat, quick outside off, drilled down to long-on. Hooda moves to 39 off 15
Gopal aims to take another legbreak away from Hooda. The batsman reaches out for it, extends his arms, and smites a six over Gopal's head
swept from the stumps again, this time straight to Mustafizur at short fine leg
length ball, on the stumps this time, Hooda attacks it with a sweep and sends the white ball flying over square leg, clears Dube in the outfield
legbreak, dangled up full and outside off. Hurricane Hooda lines it up and smokes it with the spin over cover once again
back of a length and darted into leg stump, forced down to long-on off the back foot
slower cutter outside off, barely 110ks, Dube overpitches another one. Hooda drops down to one knee and caresses it over extra-cover for six
Hooda backs away outside leg, darted shorter and wider of off. Swishes and misses
Hooda backs away outside leg, Dube goes for the yorker, misses his length and serves up a full-toss, which is slugged over the midwicket fence
low full-toss on middle, pushed down to long-on
overpitched and just a shade outside off, Dube lands it in the swinging arc of Rahul. He extends his arms and pumps it over Dube's head. 30-ball half-century for Rahul
floated on a back of a length and outside off, 113ks, hauled away to deep midwicket
back of a length and breaking away outside off, eased to sweeper cover off the back foot
tossed up slower and higher outside off, Hooda stretches out, goes low, and sweeps if firmly over square leg, finding the fence
down the track, Gopal pulls his length back, may have been a wrong'un. Quietly played back to the bowler
stump-to-stump line, back of a length, forced down to long-on once again
whisked down to long-on once again
flat and quick on middle, punched down to long-on off the back foot
squirted through cover-point via a leading edge
down the track and lofted cleanly over Tewatia's head. Floated up outside off, full, Rahul meets it early and unleashes a velvet-smooth swing
flighted on middle, Rahul backs away outside leg, collapses his back knee and drives it wide of sweeper
tossed up and outside off, this legbreak is bunted down to long-on
googly, dragged down on middle, pulled away to deep square
speared outside off, hacked away to wide long-on off the inside half
back of a length and outside off, another offbreak, forced to cover

Stokes runs in from long-on, throws himself forward, and makes it now mistake this time. Parag isn't bowling legbreaks, darts an offbreak outside off. Gayle can't quite get hold of the loft, he ends up slicing it to Stokes
dragged down outside off, hauled down to long-on off the back foot
Kedar Jadhav-esque release, patted down the ground
shortish and slashed through point
rank long-hop, outside off, with a note: "help yourself, KL" He doesn't need any second invitations. Crunched away wide of extra-cover
pumped over long-on for six. Bam! Pushed through outside off, Gayle gets closer to the pitch, extends his arms, and muscles it away
belted back to Tewatia and he drops the return catch. Darted on a back of a length and outside off, struck with so much force that it bursts out of the hands
cracked hard through the covers. Tewatia is looking to slide those googlies away from Gayle. He jumps back and flays it away through cover-point, wide of the outfielder
short, wide once again, Gayle can only flash it as far as point
slower on middle and leg, Rahul elects to hang back and taps a single down to long-on
short and outside off, googly? Lashed down to long-on
Gayle throws his bat at this 141ks ball outside off and ekes out another inside edge, this time the ball dribbles square through the leg side

Morris spins around for an lbw appeal, not given. Samson decides against another review. Full and skids through to hit the front pad, but it pitched outside leg. Gayle may have eked out an inside edge to boot
back of a length and slanting away outside off, Gayle aims leg side and misses
short and outside off, 143ks, but Gayle sizes it up and launches a pull over midwicket. Clears the outfielder. New ball, please
shorter and outside off, jumps back and forces it to deep point
Rahul is hitting over the top after the powerplay. He lines up a full ball outside off from Stokes and blasts it over extra-cover
another wrong'un, not as short as the last one. Gayle reaches out for it and chops it squarer for one
wrong'un, but the length is too short and the line is too wide, allowing Gayle to crack it away through the covers
flighted on middle and leg, bunted down to long-on

Ooops, Stokes drops Rahul at long-off! He runs across to his left, gets into position, slides onto his knees, but the ball pops out of his hands and touches the boundary. Rahul steps away outside leg and slices it over the field. He gets away with it
flat and quick, sliding in at top of off, forced back to the bowler
dropped short and sliding away outside off, Gayle goes back and slashes to sweeper cover

hip-high short ball on middle at 135ks, Gayle swats it away to deep square leg. The last couple of boundaries from Gayle has injected some urgency into the innings. Punjab Kings: 46 for 1 in the first six
you just can't pitch it up and offer width to Gayle. Right in his swinging arc, he plants his front leg and drills it over mid-on
bumper, aimed at the head, Gayle ducks out of the way
dug in short and outside off, Gayle likes the width but not this heavy length. Spliced over extra-cover
Gayle, swishes, misses and exchanges smiles with Morris. Slower-ball offcutter, the leftie swings for the hills and only connects with thin air
strikes the pads, and Morris gets some swing once again, but it pitched outside leg
quick-ish single. Gayle doesn't do these, but he completes it in the end. Full and attacking the stumps, patted wide enough of mid-on
good comeback from Mustafizur. Hits that in-between length, darted on off, no room. Jammed to the covers
pumped over Mustafizur's head. On a length and outside off, Gayle sizes it up and belts it straight of mid-on
very full and darted down leg for a wide
Rahul jumps on top of a shortish ball outside off and eases it to sweeper cover with an open bat-face. No real risks being taken by Rahul or Gayle
back of a length and outside off, a crease-bound Gayle jabs at it and ekes out an inside edge to the leg side
Mustafizur hits a hard length on off, Gayle camps back and wafts it to cover
near-yorker length delivery, tinged with swing, chipped over the cover-point region via a leading edge
slower ball, floated full on middle and leg, tucked through square leg
back of a length and shoved down the leg side for a wide
shorter and zipping into off, Morris is pounding it on a heavy length, fended off the back foot
prodded into the covers

back of a length and outside off, Rahul gets on top of the bounce and punches it handsomely to the left of sweeper cover. Vohra flings to his left and aims to swat the ball into play. He saves a double for RR
edged and threads the cordon. Morris hits that in-between length, nibbles away slightly outside off. Rahul jabs it away between slip and square-ish gully
follows the inswinger with a nice outswinger outside off, nothing doing from Gayle again
on a length and swings back in from outside off, does not threaten off, left alone

What a moment for Sakariya! He leaps for joy and roars. His team-mates are chuffed for him. Fuller than a good length and slanting away outside off. Agarwal, having jumped outside leg in order to manufacture swinging room, simply throws his bat at ball and snicks it behind to Royals' new captain
on a length and outside off, driven firmly to the off-side sweeper off the front foot
back of a length and swinging in to strike the pad as Rahul loses his balance on the flick, but this is certainly missing leg stump. Sakariya spins around for an appeal and tumbles
on a length and largely holds its line outside off, forward and pushed into the covers
another inswinger, but a bit too full, sweetly driven off the front foot between midwicket and mid-on. Agarwal has got going, but another sluggish start from Rahul
back of a length and slanting into middle, knocked off the back foot through the vacant spaces at midwicket
full and shaping down the leg side for a wide
on a length and snaking back in, more inswing for Mustafizur, rolls behind square via an inside edge
back of a length and swerving into middle, once again, Agarwal hops and fends it off

Mustafizur, too, finds inswing. This is sharper movement, on a length and nips back in to leave Agarwal in a tangle and thump the front pad just above the knee-roll. Perhaps, it was bouncing over the stumps. Samson decides against a review. Oh no, the tracker returns all three reds. Royals have missed a trick
shorter and angling away outside off, Agarwal waits for the ball to arrive, then runs it between backward point and short third man
back of a length and swinging down the leg side, diverted away fine enough past Samson for four
tighter on off, punched to the right of mid-off for an urgent single
back of a length and running away just a shade outside off, Agarwal opens the bat-face and dinks it more or less straight to short third man
short, width, thrashed past point. Agarwal reaches out for the ball and scythes it away to the right of point and left of sweeper cover
shorter and swinging in against the angle from over the wicket once again, defensively stabbed into the covers off the inside half
lovely little shape on this full inswinger, Rahul presses forward and defensively taps it to the right of the bowler

Samson can't clear deep cover. The nerveless Arshdeep wins it for the Punjab Kings. Quite fittingly, Hooda, the man who set it up for Punjab Kings, takes the catch. Fullish and outside off, seems like a cutter, it was in Samson's slot, but he ends up slicing the ball to Hooda in the outfield. It's not easy to defend at the Wankhede in dewy conditions, but Punjab have pulled it off
pitched up and outside off once again, drilled down to wide long-off. Morris wants a single, but Samson turns it down. Morris is halfway down the pitch, but has to undo his steps
on-pace full ball outside off, right in the slot for Samson. He holds his shape and crunnnnnnnnches it over cover
full-toss outside off, still hard-to-hit low full-toss, forced to extra-cover, where the Boss Chris Gayle makes a tumbling save
full and wide of off, slanting away further with the angle, not quite the yorker, carved away to sweeper cover. Richardson swoops down on the ball and keeps it to one
on-pace length ball, but well wide of off. Inside the tramline. Samson swishes and misses outside off as the bottom hand is yanked off the bat
Morris shuffles outside leg, back of a length and wide of off. Morris can't touch it
shorter and wider, better from Meredith, scythed to sweeper cover
back of a length and veering into the hips. No, Riley, you shouldn't bowl there to Samson. He nonchalantly picks it up and whips it over midwicket
back of a length and wide of off, Morris cuts it more or less straight to sweeper cover
back of a length on off, 136ks, squirted out to the covers
edged and caught by Rahul behind the stumps. Maiden IPL wicket for Meredith. Pretty full and wide of off, he asks Tewatia to reach out for it. He slashes and nicks it off to the keeper
Tewatia slinks outside leg, Richardson chases him with a yorker, squeezed through midwicket to round out a 19-run over
off-stump yorker, clipped to deep square leg
full-toss shaping down the leg side for wide
middle-stump yorker, dug out through the leg side. He hares back for the second

Samson marks his IPL captaincy debut with a century. 4,6,4: what a way to reach a hundred. Wide full-toss, scythed down to the third-man fence. He has been dropped twice, but he has made the most of it, showing everyone else how to bat at the Wankhede. He elicits a standing ovation from his team-mates and support staff
Regal stroke from Samson. Richardson can't nail the yorker either. Pitched up and outside off, he clears his front leg and punches this on-pace ball over long-off
Samson reads this slower ball outside off, 98ks. He delays his drive and pumps it over extra-cover, beats Singh to his right in the outfield
Shami doesn't find the yorker again, comes out as a full-toss on off, plinked down to long-on
Shami searches for a yorker, but pushes it too full on of, Samson plants his front leg and shovels it away to the right of long-on. He sends it to the RR dug out
hard-length delivery outside off, spliced away past a tumbling Shami
Shami aims for another yorker, misses both his line and length. Full and sliding down leg
Shami nails the yorker outside off, squirted out
bouncer from Shami, kicks up at Parag and messes with his pull. He can only tickle it behind to the keeper. Gloved to Rahul. RR need 47 off 22
Parag pre-meditates shifts across off, Shami digs it shorter and makes sure Parag doesn't get bat on his scoop
banged in short and down the leg side, Samson can't meet with a pull. Wide called
here comes the googly, flat on middle and leg, worked down to long-on. Big over for RR - 20 off it
Parag has nailed this. Pinged off the middle of the bat. M Ash's go-to ball is the googly. He has ditched it and bowls a wide legbreak. Parag pumps it over the top
clears long-off with a mis-hit. Pushed through outside off, Parag drops down to one knee and slices it over Hooda
wrong'un from M Ash, spins back in sharply as Parag has a roundhouse swipe at it...and misses. Rahul flips the bails off, but Parag's back foot is anchored in the crease
M Ash drags his length back outside off, turned through midwicket
looped up on off, full, right in Samson's swinging arc. Languidly lofted over M Ash's head for six
another wide dipper, plunges on Parag, who swishes and misses outside off
wide yorker, fine bowling from Richardson - not easy to make your IPL debut at Wankhede and bowl under lights. Jabbed to the covers
picked up and whipped over midwicket - this time from Samson. Richardson aims for the yorker, comes out as a middle-stump full-toss that disappears over midwicket
slower ball, wide of off, even slower than the last ball, 95.4ks. Samson reaches out for this and slices it over point. Replays indicate this was the back-of-the-hand variation from the Aussie
another slower dipper from Richardson,106.4ks, scooped to long-off
on a length and outside off, slower variation, clipped down to long-on off the inner half
full-toss on middle, just below the waist, plinked down to long-on
Shami replies with a lifter, Parag rises with it and drops it to point
Whoa! Samson would've been proud of this effortless flick. Fulish and on middle and leg, picked up and dispatched over midwicket
another yorker on middle, jammed out to long-on
full and on the pads, tickled away off an inside edge wide of Rahul for four
top yorker outside off, Samson can't touch it
slower ball but the length is wrong. Overpitched and outside off, laced to the right of SRK at extra-cover
low full-toss on the pads, clipped to deep midwicket

Dube can't clear Hooda at long-off. Hooda has been terrific in the outfield although this is a fairly straightforward catch. On a length and outside off, in Dube's swinging arc, but he can only slice it to the outfielder
low full-toss on middle from round the wicket, shovelled away through midwicket
dug in shorter and outside off, good response from Arshdeep. Dube splices a pull, does not carry to long-on
full-toss on off, Dube sizes it up and clouts it straight over Arshdeep's head. Dube needs to raise the tempo further for RR
M Ash takes this googly away from Dube's swinging arc again. He reaches out for the ball and slices it to sweeper cover
shortish and outside off, slashed off the back foot to point, where SRK fumbles
on a length and veering away outside off, this googly is run away to point
pushed through on off, not sure if this was the wrong'un again. Dube drops down to one knee and drags a slog-sweep to the left of long-on
wrong'un, darted away from Dube's swinging arc, swished to cover
darted full on middle and leg, decent defensive line from Ashwin, jabbed down to long-off
short and skidding into middle, tucked away through square leg

nip-backer from Meredith. He wins an lbw appeal from Chaudhary. Height may have been an issue here. Samson is on the hop and he is rapped on the front thigh in front of middle. So, he calls for a review almost immediately. Not bat involved. The tracker confirms that it's bouncing over the stumps. Meredith has to wait for his maiden IPL wicket
lifter outside off, smartly done by Samson. He rises with it and ramps it over Rahul's head. Samson marks his IPL captaincy debut with a 33-ball half-century
shortish and sliding into off, punched to wide long-on
banged in short at the body, 133.2ks, according to the speed gun, but it looked a whole lot quicker to me. Rushes Samson into a hook, spliced over fine leg for six
back of a length on middle, at 141.2ks, Dube camps back and pushes it past the bowler
wide of the crease, tossed up and spinning away outside off, driven wide of Hooda at long-off. He dives to his left and makes a sprawling stop
pushed through quicker and sliding in, Samson dashes out of the crease and only ekes out an inside edge onto the pad
back of a length and spinning into middle, Dube hangs back and forces it down to long-on
plinked down to long-on off the inner half
darts another one down the leg side for back-to-back wides
speared down the leg side
flat and quick on leg stump, whisked down to long-on
low full-toss on middle, knocked down to long-on
back of a length and outside off, Samson rides the bounce and gets it down to deep third man
banged in short and angling across off, run down to deep third man
short at the body, 140.3ks, fended back to the bowler

SRK and Agarwal converge on the ball, but neither are in a position to take this catch. Hard-length ball on off, sliced in the air. Agarwal gets into a side-on position, and finger-tips it away. Perhaps, he was put off by SRK's dive
banged in short on middle at 140ks, Samson hops, skips, and fends it off to the leg side
length and outside off, 142ks, pumped through the line once again. Samson plants his front leg and launches it over long-off
on-pace short ball outside off, eased to Meredith at sweeper cover
back of a length and outside off, punched out to sweeper cover
short, wide, scythed away square of deep third man for four

Maiden IPL scalp for Richardson. He bowls Buttler with a Bravo-esque big dipper. Barely 105ks, plunges sharply on Buttler, yorker-length variation, kisses off stump. Richardson is adapting better than Meredith to these Wankhede conditions
short and wide of off, slower ball, hacked into the leg side off the inner half
fullish and on of stump, driven through the line to long-off
another wrong'un, finishes on the pads again, deflected to short fine leg
sharp wrong'un from Ashwin. On a length and zips in to hit the pad, not short enough for the pull. Samson misses the shot altogether, but this seems to be heading down leg
wrong'un, near yorker-length, kept out
slower legbreak, Samson camps back and pushes to cover
wrong'un from Ashwin, 91ks, nurdled through midwicket with the break
on a length and outside off, Buttler dashes out of the crease and drills it over Ashwin's head
starts off with a short, quick legbreak outside off, hauled away to wide long-on
back of a length and outside off, cut off the back foot to deep point, and time for another time-out
wide full-toss, Samson reaches out for the ball and carves it away to the square boundary on the off side. The bottom hand flies off the bat, but Samson has put enough bat on ball
dipping full-toss outside off, impressive variations from Arshdeep, sliced to the covers
another slower ball, cuts away outside off. Buttler slashes and gets beaten by this offcutter outside off
slower ball, full and wide of off, Samson reaches out for the ball and slices it to deep point
Samson goes over the top again. Hip-high short ball around off, he jumps back and powers a pull over midwicket. RR pass 50 in the powerplay
on a length and outside off, 144ks, whipped away to deep square leg. Meredith leaks 18 runs from his first over
better length from Meredith. 141ks, shorter and outside off, run away to point
very full and outside off, 145.3ks, Meredith needs to drag his length back. Buttler flows forward and pumps it through the covers
Buttler jumps across off even before Meredith delivers this. On a length and just outside off, Buttler laps it away fine of long leg
short, wide outside off, Buttler uses all the pace of Meredith to his advantage and carves it in the air past point
He hits 145ks, but this is a bit too full on middle. Buttler shows the full face of the bat and drives it past the bowler
nicely done. Short of length outside off and he waits on the back foot before tapping it between short third man and point for a four in the gap
slightly slower outside off and Samson steers it to short third man

edged and dropped by KL Rahul! It was a straightforward catch for a keeper, in my view. Samson got the outside edge while driving without footwork, Rahul went to his right and even got both hands but it popped out immediately. What's with all the drops tonight?
cutting away from outside off, he's off the mark by driving it on the off side

excellent return catch from Arshdeep! And what a celebration, Vohra smacked it back and after Arshdeep grabbed it with both hands to his right, and then just looked back with his hands on the hips, with a straight face. Meme makers, hope you got a picture of that
back of a length and sliding into off stump, the ball is coming into the bat nicely, dragged away to the midwicket boundary off the inner half
Shami digs is shorter and outside off, spliced away to mid-off
sweet as.... Slightly overpitched and outside off, Samson leans into it and laces it through the gap at cover
Shami pounds it on a heavy length, gets it to skid back in sharply, cramp Samson and hit him around the groin
very full and tailing in at off stump, 140ks, driven down to mid-on
back of a length and outside off, punched back

Holes out to deep third man. Ashwin runs across to his left from deep third man, snatches at the ball, and drops it. Vohra reaches out for this length ball outside off and slices it away. Ashwin juggles, but can't catch it on the rebound either
much tighter on off. Back of a length and sliding into off, Vohra closes the bat-face early and plops a leading edge to the left of the bowler
back of a length and a bit too straight in line at 136ks, Vohra picks it up and whips it crisply behind square for another four. Richardson needs to correct his lines
on a length and outside off, 137ks, run away to point
full on the stumps, defended to the leg side
full and veering into the leg stump, Vohra shuffles across a wee bit and puts it away over the midwicket fence with a wristy flick
leg-side wide
Samson meets this shortish ball outside off with an open bat-face and dinks it to point
